{"path": "tests/test_search.py", "file_text": "
from app.api import handlers

def test_search_users():
    # Valid search
    status, data = handlers.handle_search_users({"q": "Ada"})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(data["users"]) == 1
    assert data["users"][0]["name"] == "Ada"

    # Search by email
    status, data = handlers.handle_search_users({"q": "linus@ex"})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(data["users"]) == 1
    assert data["users"][0]["name"] == "Linus"

    # Case insensitive
    status, data = handlers.handle_search_users({"q": "ADA"})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(data["users"]) == 1

    # Multiple results
    status, data = handlers.handle_search_users({"q": "a"})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(data["users"]) == 2

    # Invalid: missing
    status, data = handlers.handle_search_users({})
    assert status == 400

    # Invalid: empty
    status, data = handlers.handle_search_users({"q": ""})
    assert status == 400

    # Invalid: blank
    status, data = handlers.handle_search_users({"q": "  "})
    assert status == 400
    
    # Invalid: not string
    status, data = handlers.handle_search_users({"q": 123})
    assert status == 400
"}
